meta.title: AssignFlowView

fields.name: assignMode
fields.mapping: AssignFlowOpened.assignMode, then overwritten by any later AssignModeSwitchedToGroup/Contact event

meta.description: Drives the in-progress Assign screen: which signals are being assigned and which Assign-By mode is currently selected (starts at the default from AssignFlowOpened, then updates in place when AssignModeSwitchedToGroup/Contact occurs — no navigation, same screen re-renders).
